name: CubeSat Rideshare
description: Hitch a ride as a small passenger on someone else's rocket. Very cheap, but only for a tiny CubeSat going to Low Earth Orbit.

name: Sparrow (small launcher)
description: A small rocket for small satellites. It can reach Low Earth Orbit but cannot escape Earth's gravity.

name: Kestrel (medium launcher)
description: A workhorse rocket. Strong enough for the Moon and Mars, and for very light spacecraft going to Jupiter.

name: Condor (heavy-lift)
description: A big rocket that can send a heavy spacecraft to the outer planets.

name: Titanhawk (super heavy)
description: The most powerful rocket available. It can launch almost anything, but it is very expensive.
